get.description: Returns the latest completed Registry export, or the newest completed export on the requested UTC date. An export is considered available only when its manifest.json is present. Use `latest` or a date in yyyy-MM-dd format.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous export job for Registry resources matching the submitted search query. Supports authenticated users and authorized service clients. The completed export contains a ZIP archive and manifest.

get.description: Returns the current status and metadata for an asynchronous Registry search export job. Only the original requester can access the job.
Returns one-time download URLs for all ZIP archives in the completed search export. Only the original requester can access the download.

get.summary: Redeem a one-time Registry export download URL.
get.description: Atomically consumes the Redis-backed nonce and redirects the caller to a short-lived signed Blob Storage URL. The same endpoint is used for full Registry exports and search exports.

get.summary: Allows you to fetch graphical data for a resource.
get.description:
Provide a CTID.
The response will contain graph data for that resource and the resources that are 
connected to it, to the level of depth that is provided.

get.summary: Fetch metadata for a resource by providing its CTID.
get.description:
Make a request with a CTID.
The result will return with the metadata for that resource.

post.summary: Provide a list of CTIDs and retrieve all the metadata.
post.description:
Provide a list of CTIDs like:

- `["ce-623b6352-95e8-41d9-a788-b046aa6076f6", "ce-1eb26510-de1c-40d6-b1e4-02c35317a628"]`

The response will have a list of metadata results from each CTID in the query.

There is a max of 50 ctids allowed per request.

get.summary: Fetch statistics about the different classes in the registry.
get.description:
Provide a list of class types, such as `ceterms:Credential` and `ceterms:Organization`.

For each class, the response will provide a class label, type, the count of resources in that class (both with and without children), and the same info for its children if the class has children.

get.summary: Fetch a resource by providing its CTID.
get.description:
Make a request with a CTID.
It will return a result with the full resource.

post.summary: Provide a list of CTIDs and retrieve all the resources.
post.description:
Provide a list of CTIDs like:

- `["ce-623b6352-95e8-41d9-a788-b046aa6076f6", "ce-1eb26510-de1c-40d6-b1e4-02c35317a628"]`

The response will have a list of resource results from each CTID in the query.

There is a max of 50 ctids allowed per request.

get.summary: Fetch inverse relations for a resource
get.description:
Provide a CTID.
The response will have a list of CTIDs belonging to any inverse relations, which should be anythingthat references the resource with the provided CTID externally.

get.summary: Fetch resource data for a bnode.
get.description:
Provide the full URI for the bnode, such as `d58fa54b-6582-48cd-8a72-720f194e18b5`

The response will return a result with the full resource.

post.summary: Provide a list of bnode URIs and retrieve all the resources.
post.description:
Provide a list of bnodes like:

- `["d58fa54b-6582-48cd-8a72-720f194e18b5", "e0a4fc18-dcc8-4f69-abaa-585240420882"]`

The response will have a list of resource results from each bnode URI in the query.

There is a max of 50 URIs allowed per request.

get.description:
If `className` is provided, returns properties for that class only.
If `className` is omitted, returns properties for all main search types.

Provide `depth` for maximum nested expansion depth.

0 returns only direct and inherited properties.

1 returns direct, inherited, and one nested level.

The response will contain graph data for that resource and the resources that are 
connected to it, to the level of depth that is provided. 
Returned values are Elasticsearch dot-paths, for example: 

- ceterms:name
- ceterms:ownedBy.ceterms:name
- ceterms:ownedBy.ceterms:description

get.summary: Get all subclasses for a class, including indirect descendants.
get.description:
Preserved for other possible schema-management uses.
Provide a base class term or id.
The response will have the subclass terms.

get.summary: Get raw schema property terms for a single class.
get.description:
Provide a class term or id.
Select whether to include inherited base class properties.
The response will have the schema property terms.

get.summary: Get raw nested schema property terms for a single class.
get.description:
Preserved for other possible schema-management uses.
Provide a class term or id.
Select the maximum nested expansion depth.
The response will have dot-delimited schema property terms.

post.summary: Get human-readable labels for schema terms or nested schema property paths.
post.description:
For nested paths, each term is resolved individually and joined for display.
Example: 

`ceterms:ownedBy.ceterms:name` -> `Owned By` > `Name` 

Provide schema terms or dot-delimited property paths.
Provide preferred label language.
The response will have a dictionary of original term/path to human-readable label

get.summary: Get all values for a given property
get.description:
Provide a term or id.
The response will provide a list of the value options for the property.
If there are no value options, the response will provide an empty list.

get.summary: Get value type for a given property
get.description:
Provide a term or id.
The response will provide the types of the property value.

post.summary: Get value type for a given list of properties
post.description:
Provide a list of properties. 
The response will provide a dictionary of types for each property.

get.summary: Search for resource suggestions based on the entered query.
get.description:
Search for suggestions using:

- A `query`, which is any name, keyword, CTID, etc.

- A `size`, which is how many suggestions to return.

- A resource `type` (like `ceterms:Credential`). This defaults to all types if not included.

- A `language`, such as `en` (English), `fr` (French), or `es` (Spanish).

- Whether or not to `includeBnodes` in the results.

The response will have a list of resource results suggested for the query.

get.summary: Search for different resources from the Credential Engine registry.
get.description:
Search for resources using:

- A `query`, which is any name, keyword, CTID, etc. A request must contain at least one query or filter.

- A resource `type` (like `ceterms:Credential`). This defaults to all types if not included.

- A `language`, such as `en` (English), `fr` (French), or `es` (Spanish).

- Whether or not to `includeBnodes` in the search results.

- The `index` to query, such as `es` for Elastic Search. Right now only Elastic Search is available here and is the default

- The `indexId` for the index to search (for example, a tenancy id).

- The `page` of results to start with. 0 or leaving it blank will start from the first result.

- The `view` for the response, with more detailed options like `Detail`, or simpler options like `Ids`, which just provides the ids.

- Finally, add `filters` to the query. A request must contain at least one query or filter. 

-- Filters Example: {
  "field": "ceterms:ownedBy",
  "operator": "CONTAINS",
  "value": "ce-5a4615e2-662c-4e87-a655-924b255c5660",
} 

-- Operators include: `MATCHES`, `EQUALS`, `HAS_FIELD`, `CONTAINS`, `IN`, `UNDER`, and `STARTS_WITH`

get.summary: Fetch widget configuration by widget identifier.
get.description:
Make a request with a widget identifier.
The result will return with the configuration for that widget.

oauth2-user.description: OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with PKCE for interactive users.

oauth2-client-credentials.description: OAuth2 Client Credentials flow for service-to-service access. Client ID: consumer-api. Enter that confidential client's secret in Swagger UI.
